summary: The Construction Yard is a Nomai island on Giant's Deep where the Orbital Probe Cannon was assembled. The Nomai used Giant's Deep's natural cyclones to lift cannon components into orbit; after the Sun Station failed, the cannon was placed on indefinite hiatus.

location: The Construction Yard is an island on Giant's Deep.
The Construction Yard consists of multiple connected ringed walkways equipped with gravity panels for traversal between stations.
The outskirts of the island contain a gravity pad designed for parking the ship.
The outskirts of the island also contain cyclone shelters intended to protect against the island being thrown into orbit by a cyclone.
The Construction Yard has a gravity of approximately 2 g.
Nomai writing scattered across the Construction Yard documents the construction history of the Orbital Probe Cannon.
lore: The Construction Yard is the island where the Nomai built the Orbital Probe Cannon.
The Nomai built the cannon components on the island and then used the planet's natural cyclones to lift them into orbit for assembly.
Cassava, Conoy, and Daz were lifting cannon components into orbit when one of them sank below the planet's current to the core — something previously thought impossible.
Spire constructed a model of Giant's Deep at the Southern Observatory on Brittle Hollow to investigate how an object could pass through the current.
Daz set the cannon's maximum power setting lower than its absolute maximum, anticipating that Mallow and Avens would push it to the limit.
Cassava completed building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and led the assembly effort.
Privet was assigned to install the probe tracking system on the cannon.
Mallow and Avens were romantic partners; both worked on the Orbital Probe Cannon crew.
Cassava and Daz were romantic partners; both worked at the Construction Yard.
After the Sun Station failed and the cannon was put on hiatus, Privet left the Construction Yard to visit her brother Idaea, fearing Idaea would feel responsible for the failure.
After the Sun Station failed to induce a supernova, the Orbital Probe Cannon was placed on indefinite hiatus.
The Nomai never asked the Orbital Probe Cannon to fire during their lifetimes.
mechanics: According to a Nomai computer on the Construction Yard, a long-range probe was recently launched from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
